text: Swiftly, the ascetic, like a thunderbolt, shattered the obstacle of his austerities, the forest plant. Desiring to avoid the proximity of women, the Lord of Spirits, accompanied by his retinue, concealed himself within. The daughter of the mountain, too, having in vain fulfilled her father’s desire, and with her graceful form, out of excessive modesty before her companions, went empty-handed toward the dwelling, somehow.
